Name: More Wagashi
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[b][color=#ffd966][size=5][font=Courier New]UPDATE on 10/30/2026[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#efefef][size=4][font=Courier New]Shared ingredients have moved to [/font][/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4][font=Courier New]Yuzu More Ingredients[/font][/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=4][font=Courier New], and shared crafting equipment is provided by [/font][/size][/color][color=#ffd966][size=4][font=Courier New]Yuzu More Craftables[/font][/size][/color][size=4][font=Courier New][color=#efefef].[/color]
[color=#efefef]Please install both mods and their requirements when updating. More Wagashi contains the Japanese sweets and their recipes. You don’t need to install the other More food mods.[/color]
[color=#e69138]Remove the old More Wagashi folder before installing the updated version to avoid leaving outdated files behind.[/color][/font][/size]
[/b]


[font=Courier New][color=#ea9999][size=5][b]
New traditional ingredients[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[b][size=4][font=Courier New]1. [color=#ffd966]Mochigome (Mochi Rice)[/color]: Available at Clint's shop.[/font][/size][/b]
[b][size=4][font=Courier New]2. [color=#ffd966]Shiratamako (Glutinous Rice Flour)[/color]: Mill mochigome into shiratamako.[/font][/size][/b]
[b][size=4][font=Courier New]3. [color=#ffd966]Anko (Red Bean Paste)[/color]: Cook in your kitchen.
4. [color=#ffd966]Roast walnuts[/color]: Craft with the roaster.[/font][/size][/b]




[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New][b][font=Courier New][b][size=4]Download and unzip the file.[/size][/b][/font][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][font=Courier New][b][size=4]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size][/b][/font][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][font=Courier New][b][size=4]Keep the folder structure as it is.[/size][/b][/font][/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Courier New][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/size][/color][/b][/font]

Downloads.Description:
REMOVE the old folder first. DO NOT just overwrite when it update.

Version 4.0.0 is completely different from previous versions.
